summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill focused on BGP-based multi-gateway routing orchestration within a virtual hub. It differs semantically from peer candidates: it addresses inter-gateway transit routing (establish_multi_gateway_routing) rather than single-connection initialization (Virtual Hub Connection Configuration), operates at the hub router layer rather than individual connection setup, and is orthogonal to the knowledge_reference and safety_rule peers. No existing skills in the registry match this capability. The candidate is well-supported, operationally sound, and fills a gap in multi-gateway routing configuration workflows.
